quiz.q: Your project cost ₦30,000 more than planned. How should you treat this in your file?
options: Leave it out so the project looks perfect
Record it in the planned versus actual table and explain why
Change the planned figure to match
quiz.explain: Honest planned versus actual comparisons are the most useful part of the file and show you understand your business.

quiz.q: Which statement best explains your value to a client?
options: "My work is the best in town"
"I send a written design and quotation, plan setup backwards from guest arrival, and here are photos of 12 events I did"
quiz.explain: Specific process plus real evidence builds trust far better than adjectives.

quiz.q: Your records show you rent a backdrop frame at almost every job. What should guide your next purchase?
options: Buy the backdrop frame once it passes its break-even number of uses
quiz.explain: Use the break-even method: buy what you rent most often once owning it is clearly cheaper.

quiz.q: Which is a well-written 90-day goal?
options: Decorate four paid events and collect three written testimonials by the end of the quarter
quiz.explain: A good goal names a number and a deadline so you can measure whether you achieved it.

quiz.q: Why is it useful to photograph the empty room before setup?
options: It makes the transformation clear and proves the work is yours
quiz.explain: Before and after pairs show the transformation and are strong, honest portfolio evidence.

finalQuiz.q: A client says she wants decor that is "classy". What should you do first?
options: Ask brief questions, including colours, aso ebi photos, three pictures she loves and one she dislikes
Copy the last wedding you did
finalQuiz.explain: A structured brief turns vague words into specific, agreed decisions before you design anything.

finalQuiz.q: In a royal blue, white and silver scheme using 60-30-10, which is the best place for the 10 percent silver?
options: Candle holders, napkin rings and small props
finalQuiz.explain: The accent colour goes on small details; large surfaces carry the main colour.

finalQuiz.q: Which of these is the safest choice for candlelight on tables with chiffon runners and dried flowers?
options: Real candles blown out halfway through
finalQuiz.explain: Chiffon and dried flowers burn easily; flameless candles give the look without the fire risk.

finalQuiz.q: You need floor-length cloths for 60 inch round tables that are 30 inches high. What size cloth?
Your backdrop frame is 4 m wide. Using a fullness ratio of 1.5 to 2, how much total fabric width should you plan?
finalQuiz.explain: 4 m × 1.5 = 6 m and 4 m × 2 = 8 m, giving gathers instead of a flat sheet.

finalQuiz.q: Your costs for a job total ₦200,000. You add 10 percent contingency, then 25 percent profit on that total. What is the quote?
When should the client pay the balance for decoration?
options: Only if she is happy on the day
A few days before the event, as written on the quotation
finalQuiz.explain: Written terms with the balance due before the event protect you from unpaid work after costs are spent.

finalQuiz.q: A set of charger plates costs ₦42,000 to buy and ₦7,000 to rent each time. How many uses before buying breaks even?
Guests arrive at 4:00 pm. You want the room ready by 3:00 pm, setup takes 5 hours and you add a 1 hour buffer. When must setup start?
finalQuiz.explain: 3:00 pm minus 6 hours (5 setup + 1 buffer) is 9:00 am.

finalQuiz.q: At an outdoor party, the wind is rising and your balloon arch is moving. What is the best action?
options: Hold it by hand all day
Weight the bases with sandbags or water weights and tie the arch to fixed posts
Move it next to the generator
finalQuiz.explain: Weighting and tying prevent the arch falling on guests; this is the standard control for outdoor wind.

finalQuiz.q: Your job records show profit falling over three jobs though prices stayed the same. What should you check first?
options: Whether material prices rose after you quoted, and whether your quotes have validity dates
finalQuiz.explain: Rising costs against fixed quotes eat profit; validity dates and updated prices fix it.

finalQuiz.q: A potential client asks why she should book you. Which reply is strongest?
options: "I check the venue, send a written design and quote, finish 30 minutes before guests, and here are photos and a client message from similar events"
finalQuiz.explain: A specific process plus real evidence builds trust and justifies your price.

capstone.title: Event Decoration Execution Project
capstone.brief: Plan and, ideally, decorate one real event (for example a home birthday for 30 to 60 guests or a church fellowship reception), documented in a single project file from client brief to pack-down, with an honest comparison of planned and actual cost and time.
steps: Run the client brief and measure and photograph the venue.
Create a mood board, colour scheme with 60-30-10 notes and a focal point sketch.
Write an itemised quotation with contingency, profit, deposit and balance terms, and get written approval.
Prepare the run sheet, packing list by zone and rental order.
Set up, complete the safety and quality walkthrough, and photograph every zone before guests arrive.
Collect client feedback, fill in your job record and write a reflection with specific changes.
evidence: Client brief, venue measurements and rules
Mood board, colour scheme and focal point sketch
Run sheet, packing list and rental order
Before, during and after photos (or a fully realistic plan with real venue and prices)
Planned versus actual table, client feedback and written reflection
